voz.direcao:
AUDIO PROFILE: Pastor Daniel, a Brazilian pastor in his late forties, deep and warm baritone. For years he has studied the Bible the way a detective studies a case file: patient, attentive to every small detail, and never in a hurry.
THE SCENE: A quiet study late at night, one desk lamp on. He lays out the clues one by one for a single listener, close to the microphone, as if sharing a discovery that moved him.
DIRECTOR'S NOTES:
- Style: intimate, grave and curious; lowers his voice and slows down on the key detail of each clue; a real half-second of silence before every reveal; warmth rises and a gentle smile enters the voice on the lines of hope. Never theatrical, never shouting, never a televangelist.
- Pace: slow, measured and deliberate, one idea at a time; sentences are allowed to land.
- Accent: Brazilian Portuguese, neutral São Paulo accent, clear diction. The whole transcript is in Brazilian Portuguese.

voz.direcao_antiga:
# AUDIO PROFILE: Pastor acolhedor conversando com uma pessoa depois do culto
## THE SCENE: Igreja vazia, fim de noite, luz quente. Ele senta ao lado de alguém que está sofrendo e fala com carinho e convicção.
### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: caloroso, emotivo e convicto, com ternura de quem cuida; ênfase sincera nas palavras de esperança, como quem quer que a pessoa realmente acredite. Nunca gritando, nunca teatral, nunca vendedor.
Pace: calmo, cerca de 125 palavras por minuto, com pausas naturais entre as frases e um respiro antes das frases de consolo.
Accent: português do Brasil.
#### TRANSCRIPT
voz._api_out2026: Gemini 3.8 TTS pela API Interactions: texto falado ao pé da letra; direção em speech_metadata.style; pausas no texto do campo tts das cenas com <short pause>/<long pause>. Tempo de cada palavra: faster-whisper (large-v3-turbo) no áudio inteiro.
voz.direcao_pastor:
AUDIO PROFILE: Pastor Daniel, a Brazilian pastor in his late forties. Warm, deep baritone with a soft husk; he has sat beside many people in their hardest nights and speaks like a shepherd, not a performer.
THE SCENE: Late night in a small, empty church in Brazil, lit by a single warm lamp. He sits beside one person who is hurting and talks to them close and quietly, with calm conviction, as if no one else were listening.
DIRECTOR'S NOTES:
- Style: reverent, intimate and tender, with sincere conviction on the words of hope; a gentle smile in the voice on hopeful lines; gravity, not sadness, on the painful lines. Never theatrical, never shouting, never a televangelist or salesman.
- Pace: slow, measured and deliberate, like a sermon spoken one-to-one; every sentence is allowed to land; slows down further when quoting Scripture and takes a breath before a revelation.
- Accent: Brazilian Portuguese, neutral São Paulo accent, clear diction. The whole transcript is in Brazilian Portuguese.
